The competition

What is Formula Student?

Formula Student, known as Formula SAE outside Europe, is an international engineering competition in which university teams design, build, test and race a single seater car from scratch.

It is not only a race. Teams are judged on the engineering behind the car, on the cost and manufacturing plan, and on a business case put to a panel of industry judges, so the competition rewards sound engineering and project management as much as outright speed.

Universities from across the UK, Europe and the rest of the world compete against cars built the same way: by students, on student budgets, in roughly a year.

The season

Our plan

Four phases, twelve months, one deadline that does not move.

Sept – Dec 2026 Where we are now

Concept and Design

Setting the targets the whole car is built around. Design and chassis & suspension fix the layout and geometry, powertrain settles the engine package, aero and brakes & dynamics size their systems, and business begins the cost report and business plan.

Jan – Mar 2027

Manufacturing

Drawings become parts. Manufacturing & fabrication build the chassis and machine components, powertrain prepares the engine and cooling, and aero builds the bodywork. Business tracks every part against the cost report while social media documents the car taking shape.

Apr – Jun 2027

Build and Test

First assembly, then shakedown. Brakes & dynamics lead the brake and steering checks, powertrain gets the engine running reliably, and every system is tested to find what fails before a scrutineer does. Business rehearses the plan for the judges.

July 2027

Compete

Silverstone. Scrutineering first, then the static events, where business presents the plan and the engineers defend the design. Then acceleration, skid pad, sprint and endurance, with social media covering every day of it.
